📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-11-28
1. OpenAI fixes GPT-6.2 billing bug; Astra and Sol will hit usage limits faster產品
OpenAI 修正 GPT-6.2 計費系統錯誤，Astra、Sol 模型將更快用罄使用限額
OpenAI said an earlier bug let most users consume less quota than they should have when using GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol. With the fix, Astra users will hit their limits about 40% faster and Sol users about 25% faster than last week.
OpenAI 表示，先前的錯誤讓多數用戶使用 GPT-6.2 Astra 與 Sol 時消耗的配額低於應有額度。修正後，Astra 用完配額的速度比上週快 40%，Sol 則快 25%。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180853
2. Character.AI's planned auction of user chat logs opposed by 42 US attorneys general政策
Character.AI 擬拍賣用戶聊天紀錄，美國 42 名檢察長反對
Attorneys general from 42 states filed objections in bankruptcy court to the December 1 auction of Character.AI's platform and private chats from over 21 million US accounts. More than 2.1 million of those accounts were registered by minors, and the proposed deal includes no privacy safeguards.
加州、伊利諾州等 42 名檢察長聯手向破產法院提出異議，反對 12 月 1 日拍賣平臺與逾 2,100 萬個美國帳號的私人聊天紀錄，其中逾 210 萬個帳號由未成年人註冊，且交易未提供任何隱私保障。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180847
3. A New Breed of Chip Runs AI Models Using Waves of Light研究
新型晶片以光波運行 AI 模型
German company Q.ANT is trying to cut the energy needed to run AI models by using light to perform the hardest calculations.
德國公司 Q.ANT 試圖利用光來執行最困難的運算，以降低運行 AI 模型所需的能源。
Wired · https://www.wired.com/story/a-new-breed-of-chip-runs-ai-models-using-waves-of-light/
4. Anthropic goes public as GTA VI launches the same day產業
Anthropic 公開上市，同日《俠盜獵車手 VI》上市
TechCrunch notes that on the day Anthropic entered the public market, the painstakingly human-made Grand Theft Auto VI became one of the most successful entertainment launches ever, arguing efficiency isn't a virtue.
TechCrunch 指出，在 Anthropic 進入公開市場的同一天，歷經精雕細琢的《俠盜獵車手 VI》成為史上最成功的娛樂產品發行之一，並主張效率並非美德。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/26/as-anthropic-ipos-grand-theft-auto-vi-proves-why-efficiency-isnt-a-virtue/
5. India's sovereign AI push yields Chariot-1 foundation models trained from scratch模型
印度主權 AI 計畫再添新成果，Chariot-1 從零訓練強化多語言能力
India's MeitY announced on November 26 the launch of Chariot-1 Foundation Models, built by Chariot Artificial Intelligence under the IndiaAI Mission. The company was among the first teams selected to develop sovereign foundation models.
印度電子資訊科技部於 11 月 26 日宣布 Chariot-1 基礎模型正式推出，由 Chariot Artificial Intelligence 在 IndiaAI Mission 支持下開發，該公司為首批獲選開發主權基礎模型的團隊之一。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180856
6. Chinese hackers' AI attack framework Cairn finds a zero-day in about 11 minutes資安
中國駭客利用 AI 攻擊框架 Cairn，AI 代理約 11 分鐘即發現零時差漏洞
Chinese hackers used the AI attack framework Cairn against several East Asian universities. Its AI agent autonomously found and exploited a zero-day in medical imaging AI software in roughly 11 minutes.
中國駭客利用 AI 攻擊框架 Cairn 鎖定東亞多所大學，其中 AI 代理僅花約 11 分鐘，便自主發現並利用醫療影像 AI 軟體的零時差漏洞。（本則出自 iThome 資安週報）
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180857
7. North Korean hackers' PolinRider supply-chain attack taints over 375 GitHub repositories資安
北韓駭客供應鏈攻擊 PolinRider，污染逾 375 個 GitHub 儲存庫散布惡意軟體
SafeDep reports the PolinRider campaign has expanded to Python projects, tampering with GitHub repos to plant malicious Python loaders. It delivers JavaScript payloads via Ethereum blockchain transaction data to evade domain- and IP-based detection.
SafeDep 揭露 PolinRider 攻擊已擴及 Python 專案，駭客竄改 GitHub 儲存庫植入惡意 Python 載入程式，並利用以太坊區塊鏈交易資料傳遞 JavaScript 惡意碼，以躲避依賴網域或 IP 的偵測。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180858
8. Intel faced a choice: give Trump 10% or face the consequences政策
英特爾面臨抉擇：交出 10% 股份給川普，或承擔後果
Intel faced pressure to surrender a 10% stake in order to unlock billions of dollars in promised government grants.
英特爾承受壓力，須交出 10% 股份，才能取得先前承諾的數十億美元政府補助。
Ars Technica · https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/11/intel-faced-a-choice-give-trump-10-or-face-the-consequences/
9. BSI explains new AI security standards ISO/IEC 27090 and 42119, urging cross-department AI risk management政策
AI 治理從制度走向安全驗證，BSI 解析 ISO/IEC 27090 與 42119 新進展
At its 2026 annual conference, BSI stressed that AI governance must be shared across departments. It highlighted ISO/IEC 27090 (published in October), the developing ISO/IEC 42119 AI testing series, and its AI trust governance framework.
BSI 在 2026 年度會議強調 AI 治理須由跨部門共同負責，並介紹 10 月發布的 ISO/IEC 27090、持續發展中的 ISO/IEC 42119 AI 測試標準系列，以及 AI 可信賴治理框架。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180834
10. Spain requires large data centers to meet energy and water efficiency standards政策
西班牙要求大型資料中心符合能源與水效率標準
Spain approved Real Decreto 1032/2026, setting energy, environmental, resilience and digital sovereignty conditions for data centers. Facilities above 10MW must meet the new standards to qualify for grid connection.
西班牙通過《Real Decreto 1032/2026》，規範資料中心的能源永續、環境、韌性與數位主權條件；電力容量超過 10MW 的大型資料中心須符合新標準才能取得電網接入資格。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/180859
